requirements.quote:
Reachability information is encoded as one or more 2-tuples of
         the form <length, prefix>, whose fields are described below:
requirements.condition: Encoding reachability information
requirements.required_behavior: Encode one or more tuples, each consisting of a length followed by a prefix.
requirements.why_checkable: The NLRI parser and serializer expose tuple structure and field order.

requirements.condition: Encoding a reachability tuple
requirements.required_behavior: Encode the Length field in one octet.
requirements.why_checkable: The serialized field width is directly measurable.

requirements.quote:
The Length field indicates the length in bits of the IP
            address prefix.  A length of zero indicates a prefix that
requirements.condition: Interpreting the Length field of a reachability tuple
requirements.required_behavior: Interpret Length as the number of bits in the IP address prefix.
requirements.why_checkable: Prefix decoding can be checked with known bit lengths.

requirements.quote:
The Length field indicates the length in bits of the IP
            address prefix.  A length of zero indicates a prefix that
            matches all IP addresses (with prefix, itself, of zero
            octets).
requirements.condition: The reachability tuple has Length zero
requirements.required_behavior: Interpret the prefix as matching all IP addresses.
requirements.why_checkable: A zero-length prefix can be checked against arbitrary addresses.

requirements.quote:
The Length field indicates the length in bits of the IP
            address prefix.  A length of zero indicates a prefix that
            matches all IP addresses (with prefix, itself, of zero
            octets).
requirements.condition: The reachability tuple has Length zero
requirements.required_behavior: Use zero octets for the Prefix field.
requirements.why_checkable: The next tuple position reveals whether zero prefix bytes were consumed.

requirements.quote:
The Prefix field contains an IP address prefix, followed by
            enough trailing bits to make the end of the field fall on an
            octet boundary.  Note that the value of the trailing bits is
            irrelevant.
requirements.condition: Encoding the Prefix field
requirements.required_behavior: Place the IP address prefix first in the field.
requirements.why_checkable: Serialized prefix bits can be compared with the advertised address.

requirements.quote:
The Prefix field contains an IP address prefix, followed by
            enough trailing bits to make the end of the field fall on an
            octet boundary.  Note that the value of the trailing bits is
            irrelevant.
requirements.condition: Encoding a prefix whose bit length is not an octet multiple
requirements.required_behavior: Append enough trailing bits to end the Prefix field on an octet boundary.
requirements.why_checkable: The prefix storage length can be checked against the ceiling of its bit length divided by eight.

requirements.quote:
The Prefix field contains an IP address prefix, followed by
            enough trailing bits to make the end of the field fall on an
            octet boundary.  Note that the value of the trailing bits is
            irrelevant.
requirements.condition: Interpreting trailing alignment bits in the Prefix field
requirements.required_behavior: Treat the values of trailing bits as irrelevant.
requirements.why_checkable: Changing only padding bits must leave prefix interpretation unchanged.

requirements.quote:
The minimum length of the UPDATE message is 23 octets -- 19 octets
   for the fixed header + 2 octets for the Withdrawn Routes Length + 2
   octets for the Total Path Attribute Length (the value of Withdrawn
   Routes Length is 0 and the value of Total Path Attribute Length is
   0).
requirements.condition: Encoding or parsing an UPDATE message
requirements.required_behavior: Use a minimum UPDATE message length of 23 octets.
requirements.why_checkable: Message length boundaries are directly checkable.

requirements.quote:
The minimum length of the UPDATE message is 23 octets -- 19 octets
   for the fixed header + 2 octets for the Withdrawn Routes Length + 2
   octets for the Total Path Attribute Length (the value of Withdrawn
   Routes Length is 0 and the value of Total Path Attribute Length is
   0).
requirements.condition: Encoding the fixed header of an UPDATE message
requirements.required_behavior: Use 19 octets for the fixed header.
requirements.why_checkable: The header size can be measured from the encoding.

requirements.quote:
The minimum length of the UPDATE message is 23 octets -- 19 octets
   for the fixed header + 2 octets for the Withdrawn Routes Length + 2
   octets for the Total Path Attribute Length (the value of Withdrawn
   Routes Length is 0 and the value of Total Path Attribute Length is
   0).
requirements.condition: Encoding the Withdrawn Routes Length field of an UPDATE message
requirements.required_behavior: Use two octets for Withdrawn Routes Length.
requirements.why_checkable: The length field width is directly measurable.

requirements.quote:
The minimum length of the UPDATE message is 23 octets -- 19 octets
   for the fixed header + 2 octets for the Withdrawn Routes Length + 2
   octets for the Total Path Attribute Length (the value of Withdrawn
   Routes Length is 0 and the value of Total Path Attribute Length is
   0).
requirements.condition: Encoding the Total Path Attribute Length field of an UPDATE message
requirements.required_behavior: Use two octets for Total Path Attribute Length.
requirements.why_checkable: The length field width is directly measurable.

requirements.quote:
The minimum length of the UPDATE message is 23 octets -- 19 octets
   for the fixed header + 2 octets for the Withdrawn Routes Length + 2
   octets for the Total Path Attribute Length (the value of Withdrawn
   Routes Length is 0 and the value of Total Path Attribute Length is
   0).
requirements.condition: Encoding a minimum-length 23-octet UPDATE message
requirements.required_behavior: Set Withdrawn Routes Length to zero.
requirements.why_checkable: The minimum message fields can be inspected.

requirements.quote:
The minimum length of the UPDATE message is 23 octets -- 19 octets
   for the fixed header + 2 octets for the Withdrawn Routes Length + 2
   octets for the Total Path Attribute Length (the value of Withdrawn
   Routes Length is 0 and the value of Total Path Attribute Length is
   0).
requirements.condition: Encoding a minimum-length 23-octet UPDATE message
requirements.required_behavior: Set Total Path Attribute Length to zero.
requirements.why_checkable: The minimum message fields can be inspected.

requirements.quote:
An UPDATE message can advertise, at most, one set of path attributes,
   but multiple destinations, provided that the destinations share these
   attributes.  All path attributes contained in a given UPDATE message
   apply to all destinations carried in the NLRI field of the UPDATE
   message.
requirements.condition: Advertising routes in a single UPDATE message
requirements.required_behavior: Advertise at most one set of path attributes.
requirements.why_checkable: The encoder and parsed UPDATE structure can be checked for multiple independent attribute sets.

requirements.quote:
An UPDATE message can advertise, at most, one set of path attributes,
   but multiple destinations, provided that the destinations share these
   attributes.  All path attributes contained in a given UPDATE message
   apply to all destinations carried in the NLRI field of the UPDATE
   message.
requirements.condition: Advertising multiple destinations in a single UPDATE message
requirements.required_behavior: Multiple destinations may be advertised provided they share the advertised path attributes.
requirements.why_checkable: An UPDATE containing multiple NLRI entries can be checked for shared attributes.

requirements.quote:
An UPDATE message can advertise, at most, one set of path attributes,
   but multiple destinations, provided that the destinations share these
   attributes.  All path attributes contained in a given UPDATE message
   apply to all destinations carried in the NLRI field of the UPDATE
   message.
requirements.condition: Processing destinations carried in an UPDATE message NLRI field
requirements.required_behavior: Apply every path attribute in the UPDATE to every destination in its NLRI field.
requirements.why_checkable: Per-destination route attributes can be compared after processing the message.

requirements.quote:
An UPDATE message can list multiple routes that are to be withdrawn
   from service.  Each such route is identified by its destination
   (expressed as an IP prefix), which unambiguously identifies the route
   in the context of the BGP speaker - BGP speaker connection to which
   it has been previously advertised.
requirements.condition: Encoding or processing route withdrawals in an UPDATE message
requirements.required_behavior: Permit an UPDATE message to list multiple withdrawn routes.
requirements.why_checkable: A message containing multiple withdrawals exercises list handling.

requirements.quote:
An UPDATE message can list multiple routes that are to be withdrawn
   from service.  Each such route is identified by its destination
   (expressed as an IP prefix), which unambiguously identifies the route
   in the context of the BGP speaker - BGP speaker connection to which
   it has been previously advertised.
requirements.condition: Identifying a route withdrawn by an UPDATE message
requirements.required_behavior: Identify the withdrawn route by its destination IP prefix in the context of the BGP speaker connection on which it was previously advertised.
requirements.why_checkable: Withdrawal lookup keys and route state can be inspected for prefix and peer connection scope.

requirements.quote:
An UPDATE message might advertise only routes that are to be
   withdrawn from service, in which case the message will not include
   path attributes or Network Layer Reachability Information.
   Conversely, it may advertise only a feasible route, in which case the
   WITHDRAWN ROUTES field need not be present.
requirements.condition: Constructing an UPDATE that only withdraws routes
requirements.required_behavior: An UPDATE may contain only routes to be withdrawn.
requirements.why_checkable: The encoder and parser can be checked with withdrawal-only messages.

requirements.quote:
An UPDATE message might advertise only routes that are to be
   withdrawn from service, in which case the message will not include
   path attributes or Network Layer Reachability Information.
requirements.condition: An UPDATE advertises only routes to be withdrawn
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Include path attributes in the UPDATE.
requirements.why_checkable: The path-attribute length and contents of withdrawal-only messages can be inspected.

requirements.quote:
An UPDATE message might advertise only routes that are to be
   withdrawn from service, in which case the message will not include
   path attributes or Network Layer Reachability Information.
requirements.condition: An UPDATE advertises only routes to be withdrawn
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Include Network Layer Reachability Information in the UPDATE.
requirements.why_checkable: The NLRI content of withdrawal-only messages can be inspected.

requirements.quote:
Conversely, it may advertise only a feasible route, in which case the
   WITHDRAWN ROUTES field need not be present.
requirements.condition: An UPDATE advertises only a feasible route
requirements.required_behavior: The WITHDRAWN ROUTES field may be absent.
requirements.why_checkable: An advertisement without withdrawn-route entries checks the permitted encoding.

requirements.quote:
An UPDATE message SHOULD NOT include the same address prefix in the
   WITHDRAWN ROUTES and Network Layer Reachability Information fields.
requirements.condition: Constructing an UPDATE message
requirements.forbidden_behavior: SHOULD NOT include the same address prefix in both WITHDRAWN ROUTES and Network Layer Reachability Information.
requirements.why_checkable: Intersection of the two prefix sets checks the recommended construction rule.

requirements.quote:
An UPDATE message SHOULD NOT include the same address prefix in the
   WITHDRAWN ROUTES and Network Layer Reachability Information fields.
   However, a BGP speaker MUST be able to process UPDATE messages in
   this form.  A BGP speaker SHOULD treat an UPDATE message of this form
   as though the WITHDRAWN ROUTES do not contain the address prefix.
requirements.condition: Receiving an UPDATE that includes the same prefix in WITHDRAWN ROUTES and Network Layer Reachability Information
requirements.required_behavior: MUST be able to process the UPDATE.
requirements.why_checkable: A message containing the same prefix in both fields checks processing support.

requirements.quote:
An UPDATE message SHOULD NOT include the same address prefix in the
   WITHDRAWN ROUTES and Network Layer Reachability Information fields.
   However, a BGP speaker MUST be able to process UPDATE messages in
   this form.  A BGP speaker SHOULD treat an UPDATE message of this form
   as though the WITHDRAWN ROUTES do not contain the address prefix.
requirements.condition: Receiving an UPDATE that includes the same prefix in WITHDRAWN ROUTES and Network Layer Reachability Information
requirements.required_behavior: SHOULD process the UPDATE as though WITHDRAWN ROUTES did not contain that prefix.
requirements.why_checkable: Resulting route state and withdrawal handling can be compared with a message omitting that withdrawal.
